status: PROVED PARTIAL / FACTORIAL-AWARE LINEAR-DEGREE GRAPHON AMPLIFICATION / AUDIT-PENDING

E_framework.reason: The unrestricted source framework remains unproved; the bounded-graphon sufficient theorem strengthened from an n^(1/3-o(1)) degree window to a positive linear-degree window.

old_claim: For arbitrary fixed bounded symmetric row-centered graphons with iid latent vertices and conditionally independent edges, bounded source-scale LDA plus fixed positive product noise implies bounded noisy LDA through every degree L_n with L_n^3/n -> 0.
new_claim: For the same arbitrary fixed bounded symmetric row-centered graphon class, bounded source-scale LDA plus fixed positive product noise implies bounded noisy LDA through every degree L_n <= c(W,rho)n for some c(W,rho)>0. For every L_n=o(n), the entire positive-excess connected contribution tends to zero.
new_lemmas: Factorial-aware embedded excess count: after degree-two suppression and counting embeddings before forgetting branch/path labels, S_{e,r} <= C^r e^(3r-1) r^(1-2r).
Edge-count-first summation: the strict noisy propagation factor beta<1 converts the fixed-(e,r) bound into total excess-r activity A_r <= r(Kr/n)^r.
Linear-degree polymer consequence: choosing c<1/(2K) makes the full connected positive-excess activity uniformly summable for all degrees <=cn; cycles are already geometrically summable.
failed_or_superseded_route: The planned Schatten/branch-cancellation attack was not needed to beat the apparent n^(1/3) barrier. That barrier came from discarding s! and m! factors and summing excess before using the beta^e noise decay.
exact_gap: General S_n-invariant planted laws need not factor through iid latent vertices with conditionally independent edges. Mao's Reed-Muller/rank construction lies outside this graphon diagram factorization. The next important problem is to identify an excess/width invariant for non-edgewise-factorized computations or dependencies.
next_attack: Move toward Mao: formulate a diagram/excess expansion for finite-rank matrix computations, low-rank message-passing iterates, or bounded-width branching programs; identify the analogue of positive excess and test whether fixed noise makes it subcritical. Secondary graphon work may optimize the linear constant under normalized kernel assumptions.
source_boundary: Randomstrasse101, Anastasia Kireeva, 2026-06-05, post title problems 36-38 but first broad box displayed as Open Problem 35. Hopkins setup: fixed k, Omega finite or R, uniform Q_n on Omega^{binom(n,k)}, S_n-invariant P_n, D=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)}, fixed positive noise. Mao arXiv:2607.20318, submitted 2026-07-22, gives zero LDA through Theta((log n)^{r-1}) with a polynomial-time noisy rank distinguisher, so the unrestricted conjecture is false.
